_source: sokkan-cloud branch study-quotas (f260ada): infer/pilote-etude.md § 4 (the `GET /usage` example, verbatim), infer/gateway.py `_refuse` (the four study refusals). The bodies of 412 study_mode_required, 429 user_daily_cap and 429 user_limit_reached are what the gateway of f260ada ANSWERED (its app played in-process on a throw-away database, tenant set as in § 2 of the page: study heg-eskills-2027, audit_required, max_users_day 5; sixth identity of the day for user_limit_reached) — 11.11.2026; the 410 is the source's f-string with the date of the documented example (played with another date: same words). The gateway sends the header x-sokkan-error with the code, and NO x-should-retry and NO retry-after on any of them. Regenerate from a checkout, never by hand; tests/test_pilot_integration.py compares this file with the checkout when one is at hand (SOKKAN_CLOUD_SRC, else /root/sokkan-cloud-wt-study).
